notes.title: Update 0.1.1b - NEW DIFFICULTY and bug fix
notes.content:
[b]NEW[/b] - Hard difficulty added for each level (All timer blocks and less of them!)

[b]Fixed[/b] - Continue after completing level 1D was not working - Fixed and now takes you to the level select screen (Play through again on hard if you're bird enough!)

notes.title: Update 0.1.1a - Bug fix
notes.content: [b]Fixed[/b] - Player collision bug that would cause player to hit invisible level boundaries and teleport to floor. (Player now has a larger movable area than the cubes essentially! ːsteamhappyː )

notes.title: Derora AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h1] Derora has hatched! [/h1]

We are really excited to announce [b] Derora [/b] is now available!

You can also get a bonus [b] 10% discount [/b] for a limited time only. 

Visit the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/700540/Derora/]STORE PAGE[/url] to purchase now.

We can't wait to hear what you think about the games development so far and your thoughts for further development!

We want this to become a game shaped by its players so please do post any development ideas on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/700540/discussions/] Community Hub[/url] 

We have lots of our own plans too and will be releasing a full development roadmap in due course but to give you a taster, we definitely want to add;

- Multiplayer
- Adjustable difficulty levels
- Endless Challenge Mode
- More levels (Charting Derora's journey to back to the nest)
- More Block / Spore variations 

Happy climbing! 

Thanks

[b] Derora Devs [/b]

🐣

notes.title: Early access launch week confirmed!
notes.content:
Hello all, 

We are really excited to announce [b] Derora [/b] will launch into early access next week and we can't wait for you all to play it. 

At its core [b] Derora [/b] is a VR climbing puzzler set in a beautiful rainforest world. Our aim is create a polished and focused game that is easy to pick up, difficult to master but most importantly, [b] FUN to play!  [/b]  ːsteamhappyː 

We feel we have made a good start but we really want to hear your thoughts! Your feedback will directly influence our development plans so please do get in touch via the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/700540/discussions/] Community hub [/url]

You can also keep up-to-date by; 

- Following us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/DeroraVR/] Facebook [/url]
- Subscribing to our official [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiDBLhJD4L3YzsZSnS_e7dA] YouTube channel [/url]   
- Visiting our [url=http://www.Deroravr.com] Official website [/url]   

We have lots of exciting things planned so stay tuned! 

Thanks 

[b] Derora Devs [/b]
